proof_body:
by
  intro f M hf hM
  have hg : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) := hf.cexp
  have hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨Real.exp M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, Complex.norm_exp]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hM z)
  have hc : ∀ z w, Complex.exp (f z) = Complex.exp (f w) := fun z w => hg.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hb z w
  have hd : ∀ c, deriv f c = 0 := by
    intro c
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) (Complex.exp (f c) * deriv f c) c := (hf c).hasDerivAt.cexp
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) 0 c := by
      have : (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) = fun _ => Complex.exp (f c) := funext fun z => hc z c
      rw [this]; exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    have h3 := h1.unique h2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  exact fun z w => is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hf hd z w
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ f → (∀ z, (f z).re ≤ M) → ∀ z w, f z = f w
